description: This file defines the EscapeSqlLiteralException class, a custom RuntimeException used in the security exception package of the Fineract project to handle SQL escape errors.

classes.name: EscapeSqlLiteralException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating errors related to escaping SQL literals.

methods.name: EscapeSqlLiteralException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an instance of EscapeSqlLiteralException with a message and a cause SQLException.
